reviews.review: I like the look: glowing ghost, a different colour for each stage, hazards I can read at once. But I got stuck too much. In First Steps my run stood in front of two small spike rows for 45 seconds, and in Spike Garden even the expert gave up at a wall. That is not fun in a five-minute break. Saw Mill killed me at the first saw, Ferry Lines dropped me in pits, and Laser Gate killed me in two seconds. Crumble Bridge felt fair and tense. Spring Loaded was pretty but nobody died. Gauntlet is too hard for me.
reviews.best: Crumble Bridge is clear, tense and fair, and most players finish it.
reviews.worst: Spike Garden leaves even the high-skill player stuck at a wall until the timer ends.

reviews.review: The curve is upside down. I see pass rates of 80, 30, 27, 13, 77, 100, 53 and 20 percent, so stages 2 to 4 are harder than stages 5 and 6. Spike Garden is the worst: mid and high players stand at a step with spikes on top and give up, which is a layout fault, not a skill test. First Steps also stalls a mid player in front of a small spike pair. Laser Gate kills at 18 percent after two seconds with no safe first laser. Spring Loaded has no risk at all. Crumble Bridge teaches, then tests, and reads well.
reviews.best: Crumble Bridge introduces crumbling tiles on safe ground, adds one saw later, and lands in the target band.
reviews.worst: Spike Garden stops even the high-skill player at a spiked step with no readable way forward.

reviews.review: I like the bones: Crumble Bridge has real flow, and Saw Mill and Ferry Lines ask for timing I could route. But the curve is broken. Spike Garden stalls even the high-skill run at a step crowned with spikes, and 70 of 100 ghosts die there, which reads as a layout fault, not my error. First Steps has a mid player stuck 45 seconds beside a small spike pair. Spring Loaded is the opposite: 100 of 100 finish, zero risk, nothing to optimise. Laser Gate kills at 18% before I can read the cycle, and Gauntlet stacks a saw over a crumble gap too early.
reviews.best: Crumble Bridge: readable, fast, and the 9.4 s line still has risk in it.
reviews.worst: Spike Garden: the spiked step at about 60-70% stops even the high-skill player cold.

git.subject: v3: remove 3 places with no safe action (stages 2, 6, 8)
git.body:
Measurement (v2): 627 timeouts in 4000 bot runs; careful bots stop and wait.
- stage 2, tile 35 (123 timeouts, 85 of them high-skill): single spikes with
  2 clear tiles (64 px) between them. From a stop there, only a 6-frame hop
  on 1 exact frame lands between the spikes; a full jump (132-148 px)
  lands on the next spike. Clear run between single spikes set 2 -> 4 tiles.
- stage 2, tiles 13-19: landing zones before spikes(3) and before the step
  were 4, 3 and 2 tiles. Set to 6, 5 and 4 tiles.
- stage 6, tile 17 (74 timeouts; high-skill pass 50.9% < low-skill 92.6%):
  pad flight is about 218 px, the gap is 192 px plus up to 32 px of pad
  tile: margin -6..+26 px. Gap set 6 -> 5 tiles (160 px).
- stage 8, tile 38 (105 timeouts): pad launch up a 4-tile wall, then a
  spike 3 tiles after the edge, not visible from below. Spike moved to
  5 tiles after the edge.
